question: Should Control UI offer a per-message Markdown/plain-text copy menu, and what semantic fidelity should plain-text clipboard output preserve for code blocks, links, lists, and tables?
rationale: Current behavior establishes Markdown copy only; choosing a new interaction model and defining user-visible conversion semantics are product and UX contract decisions, not a mechanical bug repair.

options.title: Per-message copy menu
options.body: Keep the existing Markdown action and add a compact menu that explicitly lets users copy the current assistant message as Markdown or normalized plain text.

options.title: Persisted copy preference
options.body: Add a user preference that selects the default copy format, accepting a broader settings and upgrade surface.

options.title: Defer the feature
options.body: Retain the current Markdown-only behavior until there is a clearer shared plain-text export contract for the Control UI.

recommendation.title: Per-message copy menu
recommendation.body: Keep the existing Markdown action and add a compact menu that explicitly lets users copy the current assistant message as Markdown or normalized plain text.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the current behavior and recently reviewed this request’s exact Control UI path.
